regionalNotesEnglish: Qualified roofing/structural review is required for deck-repair method, inspection and authorization to cover; photographs alone are documentation, not acceptance.
France/Québec terminology for roof deck, sheathing and plywood needs regional technical review.
archivedDraft.status: separate unapproved draft; no answer, audio or progress inheritance

sourceDecisionQuestions.question: Deck/cubierta, sheathing/forro de techo and covered area/área cubierta are different structural or documentation senses. Archived platelage, panneau de support and zone recouverte need qualified trade and dictionary context before selected scored terms.

The source requires a repair photo before covering and says not to cover until the foreman checks it. Confirm what check, photo sequence and deck repair sign-off are actually required by the site/product plan; the archived French is not an authorization to cover.

The scene says workers replace damaged plywood and that a photo records what stays in the covered area. A photo alone may not establish repair adequacy or regulatory record sufficiency. Keep that domain question internal and preserve the exact source meaning in any learner answer.

Archived speaking adds showing the damaged area, measuring the repair and confirming the site inspection procedure. The current source speaking objective asks specifically for a repair photo before cover. Keep additions as separate candidate evidence, not source-pinned learner requirements.
